entities.summary: Panama is a sovereign nation in Central America, Americas. Its capital is Panama City. Official languages include Spanish. Government: Unitary presidential constitutional republic. Population: approximately 4.5 million. Area: 75,417 km². Comprehensive index for Panama covering Cuna/Kuna/Guna indigenous peoples, isthmus strategic importance, Balboa 1513 (first European to see Pacific from Americas), colonial transit route (gold/silver, Porto Bello fairs), pirate attacks (Henry Morgan 1671), Gran Colombia, separation from Colombia 1903 (US-orchestrated, Philippe Bunau-Varilla), Panama Canal 1904-14 (US built after French failure/De Lesseps), Canal Zone (US sovereignty), Torrijos-Carter Treaties 1977 (returned canal), Noriega CIA-to-prisoner, US invasion 1989, canal handover 1999, and global shipping hub.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Panama's construction of the Panama Canal had a profound impact on global trade and commerce, revolutionizing transportation between the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans. The canal's completion in 1914 saved thousands of lives and reduced travel time by months.
